assertions.text: The primary audience is the person making this decision in Kumasi: someone comparing two or three local options on a phone and looking for evidence that this business can do the job.
Local context matters: fees, the first meeting, the planning timeline and what to bring around Kumasi should be answered before a visitor is asked to enquire.

positioning.summary: The approved Brand Kit describes this business as measured, precise, material, confident, direct. Drawings as artefacts: plans, sections and material samples photographed flat, beside daylight photographs of built work. The grid is visible; white space behaves like paper.

assertions.text: Personality: measured, precise, material, confident, direct.
Tone of voice: Measured and precise. Explain the constraint, the decision and the result; avoid architectural jargon.
Positioning is a design argument, not a claim about the market: the direction should make the business recognisable without inventing an award, a client list or a heritage.

objectives.summary: Request a consultation or send a brief, after seeing how the practice thinks, what it has built and what it costs to start. The site has one primary conversion; everything else supports it.

assertions.text: Primary conversion supported by the current site: send an enquiry form.

evidence.note: Inferred from the contact or selling route the page publishes.

assertions.text: Measure the direction by qualified enquiries, not by time on page: a completed send an enquiry form with the information the business needs to reply.
The primary action appears in the first viewport on mobile and again at the end of the story; no competing secondary action may look equally important.

atmosphere.summary: Measured, material and precise. Drawings, models, junctions and daylight rather than glossy renders with no plan attached. The atmosphere is a creative proposal, not a description of how the business already feels; it should be tested in review and refined, not asserted in copy.

assertions.text: Proposed emotional register: measured, precise, material. Every section should hold that register; a playful illustration or a neon gradient would break it.

Avoid the default local-business mood: stock handshakes, generic “Welcome to Bantama Design Office”, gold gradients and template testimonials. If the business has no testimonial yet, leave the space empty and say so.

storytelling.summary: The page should read as a sequence, not a list of sections: The question the client brought → The site and its constraints → The drawing and the material decision → The building in use. Each chapter earns the next; no chapter is a grid of unsupported claims.

assertions.text: Proposed narrative arc: The question the client brought; The site and its constraints; The drawing and the material decision; The building in use.
Photography and copy must come from the business. A narrative built on stock images of another place is not this business’s story and will be rejected in review.

artDirection.summary: Drawings as artefacts: plans, sections and material samples photographed flat, beside daylight photographs of built work. The grid is visible; white space behaves like paper. The direction below extends that approved visual direction rather than replacing it.

assertions.text: Approved visual direction: Drawings as artefacts: plans, sections and material samples photographed flat, beside daylight photographs of built work. The grid is visible; white space behaves like paper.
Materials and texture: paper, graphite, concrete, timber, glass. One material may be exaggerated; all of them may not.
External references are recorded as links and notes only, with a licence status. Nothing is downloaded, traced, recoloured or presented as the Studio’s own.

layout.summary: The direction will compare at least three different composition families — not one layout with three colourways. Each must state its grid, navigation, hero idea and how it collapses at 360px.

assertions.text: Composition is chosen for the business, not for the component library: editorial columns, a cinematic frame, an asymmetric offset, a catalogue index, a quiet centre and a modular block system are all available.
Avoid the default card wall: equal rounded panels with shadows and icons are not a design idea. If a card is used, it must have a reason and a different span.
Every composition is drawn mobile-first at 360px and checked at 768px and 1440px; no essential content may appear only on a wide screen.

typography.summary: Archivo for display and Spectral for text. The grotesque sans display face carries the voice while the transitional serif body face keeps reading effortless. Compact, sturdy and unapologetic. Excellent for dense labels and navigation; body copy needs a little extra leading at 16px.

assertions.text: Approved Brand Kit type: Display — Archivo (400–700), SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Licences: SIL Open Font License 1.1. Both permit web embedding and self-hosting. The Studio does not download or redistribute font files without permission.
Language coverage is confirmed for English. If the site will publish Twi, Ewe, Ga or Dagbani, the pairing must change to a family with documented orthography coverage.

colour.summary: Colour is a system with roles, not a collection of swatches: a ground, a surface, ink, secondary ink, one accent and the text that sits on it. Contrast is computed before the palette is proposed.

assertions.text: Approved Brand Kit palette (version 1): Drawing paper #EDEEEC, Graphite #17191A, Mineral red #B23A26, Concrete #7C8586.
Contrast checks: 15.16:1, 14.18:1, 4.68:1, 5.61:1, 3.25:1. Text pairs are adjusted until they meet WCAG 2.2 AA; a palette that fails contrast is not a direction.
The accent is used sparingly and for one job: action, emphasis or a single material note. Multiple accents, decorative gradients and coloured cards are rejected in review.

photography.summary: Work from 2 approved files in the vault, art-directed for drawings, materials and daylight.

assertions.text: clinic-courtyard.jpg (Photographer licence, web use) — licensed image, approved for private prototype use.
section-drawing-scan.png (Practice-owned drawing) — other, approved for private prototype use.
Approved mark: bantama-mark.png (Client-supplied mark). The mark may appear in the prototype; it does not license the site for publication.
Remote images are references, never assets: they are not fetched, cached, displayed inline or offered as “use this image”. A new upload with provenance is the only route into the vault.

motion.summary: One motion idea carries the page: a reveal, a transition or a mask — never all of them at once. Motion clarifies sequence, gives feedback and then gets out of the way.

assertions.text: Every movement has a reduced-motion alternative that removes translation and scroll-linking while leaving the content visible and the focus order intact.
Only opacity, transform and clip-path may be animated; durations stay under 900ms and no motion may delay the first readable frame.
Hover is never the only route to information, and the primary action is never hidden behind an animation.

mobile.summary: The phone is the first canvas, not a compressed desktop. Composition, type and imagery are drawn at 360px before they are expanded.

assertions.text: Body text stays at or above 16px, tap targets at or above 44px, and no horizontal scrolling is permitted at 360px.
The primary action (send an enquiry form) is reachable in the first viewport and repeated at the end; navigation uses the same labels and order at every width.
Images are cropped for portrait first, with explicit dimensions to prevent layout shift; no full-bleed video is required to understand the page.

accessibility.summary: Accessibility is a constraint on the art direction, not a clean-up task after it. A concept that cannot meet WCAG 2.2 AA is not finished.

assertions.text: WCAG 2.2 AA: text contrast at least 4.5:1, large text and UI at least 3:1, visible focus, logical heading order and labels for every control.
Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion; no content flashes more than three times per second; animation can be paused or is not essential.
The business must supply or approve alt text, captions and transcripts for its own photography, video and audio before publication.

concepts.name: The Index
concepts.idea: Treat the whole business as a precise catalogue: numbered entries, tabular facts, and a typographic system that behaves like a well-set index. For Bantama Design Office in Kumasi, that means the work is about the site, the constraint, the drawing and the built result.
concepts.narrative: The homepage starts with a definition and the first three entries, not a hero image. Each entry carries its material, price band and availability in a fixed metadata column. The visitor can see the range immediately and trust that the list is complete. The opening line, “Everything we make, in order.”, is a creative proposal and will be replaced or approved with the business’s own wording before publication.

typography.rationale: Archivo for display and Inter for text. The two share a family, so weight and size must do the differentiating work. Compact, sturdy and unapologetic. Excellent for dense labels and navigation; body copy needs a little extra leading at 16px. The direction keeps the approved Brand Kit face and changes the supporting voice and scale.

composition.navigation: A compact index bar with numbered sections and a search-like filter for collections; sticky but shallow.
composition.hero: A title, a one-line definition and the first three entries visible immediately — the index starts above the fold.
composition.spacing: Tight rows, generous section breaks, and a visible count so the visitor knows how much there is.

imagery.direction: Uniform product or piece photography in a strict ratio, with one oversized plate per section to reward scrolling. The photograph must show the actual thing, at the actual scale.

missing: One photograph cannot carry a chapter structure. Commission at least two more details and one human frame.

concepts.name: Drawn Off-Axis
concepts.idea: Put the strongest typographic statement off-centre and let an edge, a rule or a cropped image resolve the imbalance. For Bantama Design Office in Kumasi, that means the work is about the site, the constraint, the drawing and the built result.
concepts.narrative: The page is composed as a series of deliberate tensions: a large block pushed right, a thin column of facts, an image cropped by the viewport. The visitor feels the intelligence of the arrangement before reading a word. The opening line, “The plan is the argument.”, is a creative proposal and will be replaced or approved with the business’s own wording before publication.

concepts.name: Working Drawings
concepts.idea: Compose the site like a working document: bordered cells, fixed headings and unequal spans that make the service, the process and the proof legible at a glance. For Bantama Design Office in Kumasi, that means the work is about the site, the constraint, the drawing and the built result.
concepts.narrative: The page opens with a masthead that states the business, the offer and the action in one frame. Below, a plan of bordered cells holds hours, services, credentials and a case note. Nothing floats; everything is placed. The opening line, “What we do, and how it works.”, is a creative proposal and will be replaced or approved with the business’s own wording before publication.

typography.rationale: Archivo for display and Public Sans for text. The two share a family, so weight and size must do the differentiating work. Compact, sturdy and unapologetic. Excellent for dense labels and navigation; body copy needs a little extra leading at 16px. The direction keeps the approved Brand Kit face and changes the supporting voice and scale.

composition.label: Modular blocks
composition.grid: 12 columns, 0px gutter, margins 0px mobile / 0px desktop, maximum 1440px. Cells share 1px rules rather than gaps; spans vary (3/6/4) so the grid never reads as a card wall.
composition.navigation: A utility bar with the practical information (hours, location, booking) and a separate primary menu.
composition.hero: A bordered masthead with the business name, one line of positioning and the primary action in the same frame.
composition.spacing: A visible modular beat; padding inside cells is consistent, while cell spans vary.
composition.imageComposition: Images fill cells edge to edge; crops are chosen to align with the rule structure.

imagery.direction: Documentary photographs that fill cells edge to edge: the premises, the team at work, a detail of the service. One portrait per cell, never a collage.
imagery.treatment: Square or 4:3 crops aligned to the rules; no rounded corners; captions sit inside the cell.
